page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m4.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile is built on the x86_64 architecture and features an AMD EPYC processor operating at 2.25 GHz. It provides 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory distribution of 4.0 GB per virtual core.

Hardware accelerators are not bundled with this configuration, as the GPU count is zero. The instance does not feature onboard local storage, necessitating external network-attached cloud disks for persistent storage needs. For network connectivity, the server provides a baseline throughput of 6 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its symmetric CPU and memory density, the ecs.u2a-c1m4.4xlarge provides predictable core capacity without the overhead of specialized hardware. This resource structure aligns with intermediate enterprise workloads, including web application servers, container hosts, distributed microservices, and general backend business logic that rely on detached network storage.
